verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software product, so reading its source under an open license is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only legal services, published pricing and small web resources (an investor-readiness tool, a UPC tracker, cap table downloads), with no indication of any software source or licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
